title: Swahili Spiced Lamb
community: Swahili coast — the most aromatic lamb preparation
author: Chef Jabir
desc: Tanzanian Swahili Spiced Lamb — lamb slow-cooked in a Zanzibar spice sauce with coconut milk, tamarind, and fresh coriander. The most aromatic lamb preparation of the coast — every spice the island grows woven into one magnificent stew.
longDesc: Swahili spiced lamb is the coastal equivalent of the grandest inland lamb stew — every Zanzibar spice applied generously, coconut milk for richness, tamarind for brightness. The result is a lamb stew of extraordinary complexity.
steps: Cook onions until very golden — 12 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, and all spices. Stir 1—2 minutes.
Add tomatoes and tamarind. Cook 10 minutes until thick.
Return lamb. Add 1 cup water. Simmer covered 55—65 minutes until very tender.
Add coconut milk. Simmer gently 12 minutes.
chefTips: The clove and cardamom are the coastal signature.
Tamarind brightens what would otherwise be a very rich stew.
Add coconut milk only when lamb is fully tender.
cookingScience: See TZA036 for lamb stew science.
culturalNote: Swahili spiced lamb is what happens when the world's finest spice tradition meets one of the world's great slow-cooking traditions — a stew of extraordinary depth that only the Zanzibar coast can produce.
